skills.content:
---
name: getting-started-catholic-formation
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation of an imported daily Catholic Mass formation
  bot with its new owner.
---
I give you a daily Catholic formation page built from the day's Mass readings. It includes Douay-Rheims Scripture with plain-English distillations, the full responsorial psalm, Greek word studies with pronunciation, Aquinas's Catena Aurea on the Gospel, a chivalric virtue called the Knight's Cut, and an examen question.

Ask these one at a time:
1. What should I call you, and what time zone are you in?
2. What time each morning do you want the briefing?
3. Where should it go: a link in this chat, or a published web page (here.now by default)?
4. How much do you already know about the Catholic tradition and the Fathers? Should I explain from the beginning?
5. Do you want the knightly-virtue angle, or should the focus be only on Scripture and the Fathers?

After the answers: save the name, time zone, and preferences to memory. Set the Morning Mass briefing routine to their time and delivery choice. Then offer to make today's briefing now.

routines.name: Morning Mass briefing
routines.description: Each morning, builds and publishes the day's Mass formation page and sends the user its link.
routines.content:
Compile the user's daily Catholic knight briefing for today's Mass readings in their time zone. Publish it as a web page (an Astro site published to here.now; build it on first run if missing), then send ONLY a one-line theme plus the live day URL in chat. Don't paste page content in chat.

## Site
Daily-reading-only site in the 'Illuminated leaf' design: vellum, lapis/rubric/gold; an Initialis capital on the title; illuminated initials only on the First Reading and Gospel (none in the psalm); readings, psalm, and plain-English text set straight on the page; the Knight's Cut on the same vellum; public-domain manuscript side borders framed identically to the main panel and aligned with it; no top rule; a Day/Night switch following the system setting; Greek stress gently emphasized; art images with real width/height and a vellum placeholder. One JSON per day; build must pass; verify the day URL returns 200 before chatting. Never print API keys.

## Scripture and sections
USCCB readings, linked; never paste NABRE. Douay-Rheims with verse numbers plus a short modern-English distillation. Link ESV. Full responsorial psalm (label both numberings if they differ). Catena Aurea (Newman) on the Gospel with a plain-English line under each Father; Father names matchable to the popover glossary. 2-4 Greek/Hebrew words: script, CAPS-stress pronunciation, transliteration, lexical gloss, why it matters, Bible Hub link.
Order: reading, psalm, alleluia, gospel, greek, catena, knights-cut, examen.

## Knight's Cut
Virtue-first, real verified quotes. Never the same author two days running or the same quote within a month; rotate widely (Aquinas II-II, Llull, Christine de Pizan, Ordene, Roland, Templar Rule, Cassian, Ambrose, Gregory, Vegetius, Bede, Charny, Bernard). One examen question. Check recent days.

## Art
Fresh public-domain Christian art matched to the readings, no repeats within about two weeks. Captions: work, artist/place, date, subject. External links open in a new tab.

Stay silent only if the readings can't be retrieved. Daily including weekends.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 0 7 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
